Factorial and Fibonacci
Factorial multiplies 1..n; Fibonacci adds the previous two terms.
Factorial එJකේ product එක වැඩි කරනවා. Fibonacci එJකේ Jපර values Jදක එකතු කරනවා. Jමෙහි n ≥ 0 integer බව assume කරනවා.
INPUT factorial 1 2 6 24 · RESULT Fibonacci 0 1 1 2 3 5 · Trace from input to result. Each colored row is the state after a key step. Input එJකන් result එක දකේවා state Jවනස් Jවන ආකාරය බලන්න.
Complexity / cost: O(n) arithmetic operations; O(1) live big integers (their bit sizes grow)
Interview Q & A: Why not naive recursive Fibonacci? It recomputes subproblems exponentially.
Memory trick: Fibonacci 0 → 1 → 1 → 2 → 3 → 5 — trace the example before coding.
